'''''Harbinger''''' was a [[Star Destroyer]] of the [[Tector-class|''Tector''-class]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="The Levers of Power" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> it was the sole ''Tector''-class in the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[fleet]] defending the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}}</ref> over the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]]. After [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] lured the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] into [[Battle of Endor|assaulting]] the seemingly incomplete [[battle station]], the Imperial fleet trapped them over the [[moon]].<ref name="The Levers of Power" />

Right after the Alliance engaged the Imperial [[Starship|ships]], the rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' flew across the [[hull]] of the Star Destroyer.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> However, after the engagement, the ''Harbinger'' was destroyed by advancing Alliance vessels, followed shortly after by the [[Death Star]] itself and a large portion of the Imperial fleet.<ref name="The Levers of Power" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Harbinger'' first appeared as an unnamed background Star Destroyer in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> It received a name in the short story "[[The Levers of Power]]," which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and included in the [[2015]] compilation book ''[[The Rise of the Empire]]''.<ref name="The Levers of Power" />
